stem: The number of accidents per 3-month period on a certain road has the distribution $\text{Po}(\lambda)$. In the past the value of $\lambda$ has been 5.7. Following some changes to the road, the council carries out a hypothesis test to determine whether the value of $\lambda$ has decreased. If there are fewer than 3 accidents in a randomly chosen 3-month period, the council will conclude that the value of $\lambda$ has decreased.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find the probability of a Type I error.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Find the probability of a Type II error if the mean number of accidents per 3-month period is now actually 0.9.
